dispatch_analysis.classification: Test application lifetime defect: asynchronous editor work spans separately isolated dispatch scopes.

source_evidence.finding: DispatchCore creates an isolated application for each dispatch when isolation is enabled.
The application is disposed when the dispatched action finishes.
Isolated application disposal resets the dispatcher and locator scope and restores synchronization context.
Assembly sessions default to PerTest isolation unless explicitly overridden.

dispatch_analysis.historical_test_problem: The synchronous dispatch opening the editor can finish before async-void LoadDna resumes after its engine export. Subsequent predicate polls create fresh application scopes.
